title: cacalia riedelii
intro: Cacalia riedelii, commonly known as Mexican cañuela, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, as well as its potential to support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia riedelii include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-ulcer properties, making it a promising remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
